subject: Request: Exec sign-off for uptime remedy & pricing concession (NovaBio)
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novabio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Alvarez <chris.alvarez@novabio.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on SLA & pricing for POC

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and throughput. As we scope the proof-of-concept, two items came up from procurement/security:

- SLA: NovaBio requires 99.99% uptime for the prod-equivalent endpoints. For the POC we can accept lower, but procurement is asking what remedies/redress look like if latency or availability targets miss during the POC window.
- Pricing: we were hoping to structure a modest POC discount and a single remedy cap rather than unlimited credits.

Can you share any precedent for limited service-credit caps and whether Redwood can commit to a reduced remedy table for an early-stage customer like us? I can loop in procurement if helpful.

Attaching our internal SOW draft for context (see NovaBio-SOW-draft.pdf).

Cheers,
Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships, NovaBio

Attachments: NovaBio-SOW-draft.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novabio.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Chris Alvarez <chris.alvarez@novabio.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on SLA & pricing for POC

Emily — thanks for the note and for sharing the SOW. Quick replies:

- We can offer a POC-specific uptime target of 99.95% with an agreed-upon latency SLO for the endpoints you used in the demo.
- For remedies, the standard hosted SLA includes per-month service credits escalating by severity. However, we have some flexibility for POC terms to cap total credits.

I'll pull Deal Desk and Legal into this thread to propose concrete language and a pricing concession. Aditya — can you propose a conservative remediation cap and discount that we can send back to NovaBio for procurement review? Marcus, please flag any legal must-haves for the remedy table so we can keep the language simple.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: referenced SOW

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for uptime remedy & pricing concession (NovaBio)

Mina / Steph / Marcus —

Quick proposal from Deal Desk based on similar POC arrangements:

- Uptime for POC: 99.95% (30-day POC window).
- Remedy: capped service credit equal to a maximum of 3 months of monthly recurring revenue (MRR) during the POC period. Credits tiered by severity but total not to exceed 3x monthly fee.
- Pricing concession: one-time 15% off list for the first 12 months if NovaBio signs Dedicated capacity (min committed GPU hours) and 12-month term.

Rationale: caps limit financial exposure while keeping a visible incentive. If Legal is comfortable with the credit cap language, this is our ask for executive sign-off.

Emily / Chris — let us know if procurement can live with the 3x MRR cap and the Dedicated commitment. If not, we can model different caps but this is our preferred position.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Deal Desk Analyst

Attachments: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for uptime remedy & pricing concession (NovaBio)

Team — legal review notes:

- Cap of 3x MRR for the POC is acceptable, but we need to be explicit about how MRR is defined (list price vs. actual invoiced amount) — recommend "monthly invoice amount" to avoid disputes.
- Remedies must be the sole and exclusive remedy for availability/latency failures during the POC period; add a short sentence to the SOW clarifying that this remedy table supersedes other potential claims.
- Exclude force majeure and scheduled maintenance windows; define scheduled maintenance notice period (48 hours).

I'll attach suggested redline language to the SOW for Mina to share with NovaBio.

Marcus Lin
Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: suggested-redline-SOW.txt

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@novabio.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request: NovaBio POC — remedy cap + discount (summary)

Laura — short ask for exec sign-off. Background and recommendation below; full thread attached.

Summary:
- Account: NovaBio Therapeutics (pre-revenue partner; strategic biotech).
- Ask: Approve a POC-specific SLA/remedy table and a commercial concession.
- Deal Desk recommended terms: 99.95% uptime for 30-day POC; remedy capped at 3x monthly invoice amount; 15% one-time discount on first 12 months if customer commits to Dedicated capacity and 12-month term.
- Legal (Marcus): requests explicit definition of "monthly invoice amount" and remedy exclusivity; also wants 48-hour maintenance-notice carveout.

Why approve: This is a high-visibility proof-of-concept with potential to convert to a multi-region deployment. The Dedicated commitment materially reduces our operational variance and makes the credit cap acceptable.

Risks: If the customer declines Dedicated commitment, exposure increases. If we need to waive the Dedicated requirement we'll need a materially lower credit cap or an expanded pricing concession.

Requested decision: Approve the proposed package (99.95% uptime, 3x monthly invoice cap for POC, 15% first-year discount) or provide alternative guidance. If approved, I'll update the SOW using Marcus' redline and send to NovaBio + procurement.

Thanks,
Mina

Attachments: NovaBio-SOW-draft.pdf, suggested-redline-SOW.txt, NovaBio-SOC2-excerpt.pdf

On disclosure: Emily/Chris — this email includes internal exec routing for transparency. Please expect a one-line final confirmation from our side once Laura signs off.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novabio.com>, Chris Alvarez <chris.alvarez@novabio.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: NovaBio POC — remedy cap + discount (summary)

Mina — approved with one condition.

Decision: Approve the package as proposed (99.95% uptime for 30-day POC; remedy cap = 3x monthly invoice amount; 15% one-time discount for first 12 months).

Condition: Customer must sign a Dedicated capacity commitment in the SOW (minimum committed GPU hours to be defined by Product Ops) and commit to a 12-month term. If NovaBio declines Dedicated, we do NOT approve this concession and will revert to standard hosted SLA/no discount.

Mina please: (1) update the SOW with Marcus' redlines (define monthly invoice amount + exclusivity language), (2) add the Dedicated commitment clause, (3) obtain countersignature and route for internal billing to set up the 15% invoice credit.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval-note (internal)
